text: The duration of study lasts for one semester or more. School starts at the beginning of each March and September, and enrollment is for the whole year. Required Chinese courses cover basic Chinese, listening, speaking, reading, and writing. During the period of study many practice activities will be arranged, such as visiting the famous scenic spots in Hunan, watching dragon and lion dancing,etc. A certificate will be offered to the student who successfully completes all the required courses.
